title: Resolution urging Albany to require full insurance coverage for lactation care
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass, and the Governor to sign, legislation requiring insurers to cover all lactation consultation and counseling services without restrictions and to reimburse providers accordingly. It cites concerns that insurers limit coverage by visit number, timeframe or provider network, and that reimbursement rates for lactation consultants have stagnated. A 2025 study found New York State had 1,057 IBCLCs, or 23.7 per 100,000 women, below the national average of 25.5.
